output:

    toc: true

    number_sections: true
params:
  data_path: "Data/extracted_data/processed_cholera_climate_systematic_review_extract_into_sheets.csv"
---

```{r setup, echo=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
source(here::here("Analysis/utils.R"))
library(gtsummary)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)
library(survey)

# Load the dataset from the file path
data <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$data_path)) %>% 
  mutate(
    admin_level = case_when(
      new_admin == "supranational" ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ new_admin
    )
  ) %>% 
  add_continent("eff_country") %>% 
  mutate(
    exp_class =factor(exp_class, levels = c("precipitation","temperature","flood","drought"))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(across(c("eff_tl", "eff_tr"), ~ char_to_date(.) %>% as.Date())) %>%
  mutate(study_year_tl = lubridate::year(eff_tl),
         study_year_tr = lubridate::year(eff_tr)) %>% 
  filter_final_analysis_dataset(
    ., criteria = list(expr(study_year_tl > 1961))
  ) # remove papers/estimates before 7th pandemic
```

# Exposure summary
```{r}
# Total number of studies
total_studies <- n_distinct(data$studykey)

exposure_counts <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, exp_class) %>%
  count(exp_class, name = "n_studies") %>%
  add_row(exp_class = "Total", n_studies = total_studies)

exposure_counts %>%
  rename(Exposure = exp_class, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Exposure, values_from = `Number of Studies`) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "Number of Studies") %>%
  relocate(Metric) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Exposure Count Summary") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Metric, decimals = 0)

```

# Outcome summary
```{r}
# Outcome counts
outcome_counts <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_metric) %>%
  count(out_class_metric, name = "n_studies") %>%
  add_row(out_class_metric = "Total", n_studies = total_studies)

outcome_counts %>%
  rename(`Outcome` = out_class_metric, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Overall Outcome Summary") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Number of Studies`, decimals = 0)

```

## Outcome summary by exposure
```{r}
outcome_tbl <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_metric, exp_class) %>%
  count(out_class_metric, exp_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exp_class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(Outcome = out_class_metric)

outcome_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Outcome Summary by Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Outcome, decimals = 0)

```

## Outcome summary by continent
```{r}
outcome_tbl <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_metric, continent) %>%
  count(out_class_metric, continent) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = continent,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(Outcome = out_class_metric)

outcome_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Outcome Summary by Outcome") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Outcome, decimals = 0)

```

# Study period summary 
```{r}
period_table <- data %>% 
  mutate(across(c("eff_tl", "eff_tr"), ~ char_to_date(.) %>% as.Date())) %>% 
  mutate(study_year_tl = lubridate::year(eff_tl),
         study_year_tr = lubridate::year(eff_tr)) %>% 
  mutate(duration = as.numeric(eff_tr-eff_tl)) %>% 
  mutate(study_duration = case_when(
    duration <= 366 ~ "<1 year",
    duration <= 366*2 ~ "1-2 years",
    duration <= 366*5 ~ "2-5 years",
    duration <= 366*10 ~ "5-10 years",
    TRUE ~ ">10 years"
  ))

```

## Study period coverage 
```{r}
period_table %>%
  summarize(
    `Earliest Study Year` = min(study_year_tl, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Latest Study Year` = max(study_year_tr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Overall Study Period Coverage") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0)
```

### Study period by exposure
```{r}
period_table %>% 
  group_by(exp_class) %>% 
  summarize(
    `Earliest Study Year` = min(study_year_tl, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Latest Study Year` = max(study_year_tr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Exposure = exp_class) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Earliest Study Year`, `Latest Study Year`), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Exposure, values_from = Value) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Period by Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Metric, decimals = 0)

```

### Study period by outcome
```{r}

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Outcome = out_class_metric) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Earliest Study Year`, `Latest Study Year`), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Outcome, values_from = Value) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Period by Outcome") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Metric, decimals = 0)

```

### Study period by continent
```{r}
period_table %>%

    `Latest Study Year` = max(study_year_tr, na.rm = TRUE),
```

# Study population summary
```{r}
case_class <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_case_presentation) %>%
  mutate(case_type = case_when(
    out_class_case_presentation == "bacteriologically confirmed cases only" ~ "Confirmed",
    out_class_case_presentation == "suspected cases only" ~ "Suspected",
    out_class_case_presentation == "deaths" ~ "Deaths",
    out_class_case_presentation == "sero-incidence infections and bacteriologically confirmed cases" ~ "Sero-incidence and Confirmed cases",
    out_class_case_presentation == "sero-incidence infections, bacteriologically confirmed cases and suspected cases" ~ "Sero-incidence and Confirmed and Suspected cases",
    out_class_case_presentation == "not stated" ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ "Mixed"
  )) %>%
```


# Paper quality distribution
```{r}
stats_all <- generate_summary_stats(data)

# Add scores to dataframe
data_scores <- data %>% 
  make_scores() %>% 
  mutate(hq_score = ifelse(tot_score == 11, "complete-score", "imperfect-score"))

stats_by_continent <- map(
  unique(data$continent), 
  function(x) {
    data %>% 
      filter(continent == x) %>% 
      generate_summary_stats()
  }
) %>% 
  magrittr::set_names(unique(data$continent))

stats_by_score <- map(
  unique(data_scores$hq_score), 
  function(x) {
    data_scores %>% 
      filter(hq_score == x) %>% 
      generate_summary_stats()
  }
) %>% 
  magrittr::set_names(unique(data_scores$hq_score))


study_counts <- stats_all$study_counts
```

## Paper quality distribution by exposure
```{r}
stats_all$quality_summary_by_exp %>%
  group_by(exp_class) %>% 
  summarize(
    `Mean (IQR)` = paste0(
      round(mean(avg_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      " (", 
      quantile(avg_tot_score_est, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
      "-", 
      quantile(avg_tot_score_est, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 
      ")"
    ),
    Min = as.character(round(min(avg_tot_score_est),2)),
    Max = as.character(round(max(avg_tot_score_est),2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -exp_class, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_class, values_from = Value) %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(title = "Distribution of Total Quality Score at the Paper level By Exposure")
```

```{r}

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
  gt::tab_header(title = "Distribution of Total Quality Score at the Paper level By Outcome")
```

# Paper quality summary
## Paper quality summary by exposure
```{r}
score_summary_by_exp <- stats_all$quality_summary_by_exp %>%
  mutate(
    score_range = case_when(
      avg_tot_score_est == 11 ~ "Score = 11",
      avg_tot_score_est == 5 ~ "Score = 5",
      avg_tot_score_est >5 & avg_tot_score_est < 11 ~ "Score >5 – <11"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(exp_class, score_range) %>%
  summarize(n = sum(n_studies, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename(`Score Range` = score_range)

score_summary_by_exp %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Summary of Total Quality Scores by Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -`Score Range`, decimals = 0)

```

# Table 1
```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(duration = as.numeric(eff_tr - eff_tl)) %>%
  mutate(study_duration = case_when(
    duration <= 366 ~ "<1 year",
    duration <= 366*2 ~ "1-2 years",
    duration <= 366*5 ~ "2-5 years",
    duration <= 366*10 ~ "5-10 years",
    TRUE ~ ">10 years"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(new_out_class_case_presentation = case_when(
    out_class_case_presentation == "bacteriologically confirmed cases only" ~ "Confirmed",
    out_class_case_presentation == "suspected cases only" ~ "Suspected",
    out_class_case_presentation == "deaths" ~ "Deaths",
    out_class_case_presentation == "sero-incidence infections and bacteriologically confirmed cases" ~ "Sero-incidence and Confirmed cases",
    out_class_case_presentation == "sero-incidence infections, bacteriologically confirmed cases and suspected cases" ~ "Sero-incidence and Confirmed and Suspected cases",
    out_class_case_presentation == "not stated" ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ "Mixed"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    sig_report = case_when(
      a_uncert_def == "not stated" ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ TRUE
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(out_temp_scale = factor(out_temp_scale,
                                 levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 99),
                                 labels = c("0 day",
                                            "1-14 days",
                                            "15-30 days",
                                            "31-365 days",
                                            ">365 days",
                                            "missing")))

# Helper function: generate summary table with Total column
make_summary_table1 <- function(data, var, rename_var = NULL, output_cols = c("Overall","by exp"),  exp_class_order = c("precipitation", "temperature", "flood","drought","Overall")
) {
  if(c("by exp") %in% output_cols){
    tmp_exp <- data %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(var), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
      distinct(studykey, exp_class, .data[[var]]) %>%
      count(.data[[var]], exp_class) 
  } else {
    tmp_exp <- data.frame()
  }
  
  if(c("Overall") %in% output_cols){
    tmp_total <- data %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(var), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
      distinct(studykey, .data[[var]]) %>%
      count(.data[[var]]) %>%
      mutate(exp_class="Overall")    
  } else {
    tmp_total <- data.frame()
  }
  
  if(!nrow(tmp_exp) == 0 & !nrow(tmp_total) == 0){
    tmp <- tmp_exp %>%
      bind_rows(tmp_total)
  } else if(nrow(tmp_exp) == 0){
    tmp <- tmp_total
  } else {
    tmp <- tmp_exp
  }
  
  tmp_long <- tmp %>% 
    rename(!!rename_var := .data[[var]])
  
  if (!is.null(exp_class_order)) {
    tmp_long <- tmp_long %>%
      mutate(exp_class = factor(exp_class, levels = exp_class_order))
  }

  # Create a survey design object to account for weights
  survey_design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, data = tmp_long, weights = ~n)
  
  summary_tbl <- tbl_svysummary(
    survey_design,  # Use the survey design object
    by = exp_class,  # Group by Category (Africa, Asia, Other)
    includ = Category,
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),  # Show counts and percentages
    missing = "no"  # Exclude missing data from summary
  )
  
  summary_tbl <- as_tibble(summary_tbl)
  
  # Round the percentage
  summary_tbl <- summary_tbl %>% 
    mutate(across(contains("%"), ~ceiling(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", .))), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

  return(as_gtsummary(summary_tbl))
}
```

### Table 1. Study country
```{r}
get_country_count_by_continent <- function(data, ctn = NULL, ctn_col = "continent") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)

  clean_data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(ctn_col, "eff_country")), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
    separate_rows(eff_country, sep = "\\|") %>%
    distinct(studykey, .data[[ctn_col]], eff_country, exp_class) %>%
    rename(continent = !!sym(ctn_col))

  if (!is.null(ctn)) {
    clean_data <- clean_data %>%
      filter(continent == tolower(ctn))
  }

  top_by_exp <- clean_data %>%
    group_by(exp_class, eff_country) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(studykey), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(exp_class) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = n, n = 1, with_ties = T) %>%
    ungroup()

  top_country_grid <- top_by_exp %>%
    distinct(eff_country) %>%
    crossing(exp_class = unique(clean_data$exp_class))

  country_counts <- clean_data %>%
    semi_join(top_country_grid, by = "eff_country") %>%
    group_by(eff_country, exp_class) %>%
    summarise(n_papers = n_distinct(studykey), .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(top_country_grid, by = c("eff_country", "exp_class")) %>%
    mutate(n_papers = replace_na(n_papers, 0)) %>%
    arrange(eff_country, exp_class)

  top_countries <- unique(top_by_exp$eff_country)

  others_counts <- clean_data %>%
    filter(!eff_country %in% top_countries) %>%
    group_by(exp_class) %>%
    summarise(
      eff_country = "Others",
      n_papers = n_distinct(studykey),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  country_counts_with_others <- bind_rows(country_counts, others_counts) %>%
    arrange(eff_country, exp_class)

  return(country_counts_with_others)
}


get_country_count <- function(data, country_continent_by_ctn, ctn = "africa", ctn_col = "continent") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(survey)
  library(gtsummary)

  clean_data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(ctn_col, "eff_country")), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
    separate_rows(eff_country, sep = "\\|") %>%
    distinct(studykey, !!sym(ctn_col), eff_country)

  continent_data <- clean_data %>%
    filter(!!sym(ctn_col) == tolower(ctn))

  top_countries <- unique(country_continent_by_ctn$eff_country)

  country_counts <- continent_data %>%
    filter(eff_country %in% top_countries) %>%
    group_by(eff_country) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n_distinct(studykey),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  other_n <- continent_data %>%
    filter(!eff_country %in% top_countries) %>%
    pull(studykey) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()

  total_n <- continent_data %>%
    pull(studykey) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()
  
  # Other countries
  summary_data <- country_counts %>%
    select(eff_country, n) %>%
    mutate(continent = ctn) %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        eff_country = "Others",
        n = other_n,
        continent = ctn
      )
    ) %>%
    relocate(continent)

  survey_design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, data = summary_data, weights = ~n)

  tbl <- tbl_svysummary(
    survey_design,
    by = "continent",
    include = "eff_country",
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
    modify_caption(glue::glue("**Summary Table for Continent (overall): {str_to_title(ctn)}**"))

  # Overall
  overall_row <- tibble(
    variable = "eff_country",
    group = NA,
    label = "Overall",
    stat_1 = as.character(total_n)
  )

  tbl_df <- as_tibble(tbl$table_body)
  final_tbl <- tbl %>%
    modify_table_body(
      ~ bind_rows(.x, overall_row)
    )

  return(final_tbl)
}
```

```{r}
# Study Quality
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    exp_temp_tf = ifelse(exp_temp_scale == 99, 0, 1),
    exp_spatial_tf = ifelse(exp_spatial_scale == "not stated", 0, 1),
    exp_source_tf = ifelse(exp_source == "not stated", 0, 1),
    out_class_case_presentation_tf = ifelse(out_class_case_presentation == "not stated", 0, 1),
    out_temp_tf = ifelse(out_temp_scale == 99, 0, 1),
    out_spatial_tf = ifelse(out_spatial_scale == "not stated", 0, 1),
    out_case_df_tf = ifelse(case_def_raw == "not stated", 0, 1),
    a_match_tf = ifelse(exp_out_spatial_scale_match == "unknown", 0, 1),
    a_class_tf = ifelse(a_effect == "not stated", 0, 1),
    a_adjusted_tf = ifelse(a_adjusted == "not stated", 0, 1),
    a_uncert_def_tf = ifelse(a_uncert_def == "not stated", 0, 1),
    tot_score = exp_temp_tf + exp_spatial_tf + exp_source_tf + out_class_case_presentation_tf +
      out_spatial_tf + out_temp_tf + out_case_df_tf + a_match_tf +
      a_class_tf + a_adjusted_tf + a_uncert_def_tf,
    exp_tot_score = exp_temp_tf + exp_spatial_tf + exp_source_tf,
    out_tot_score = out_class_case_presentation_tf + out_spatial_tf + out_temp_tf + out_case_df_tf,
    a_tot_score = a_match_tf + a_class_tf + a_adjusted_tf + a_uncert_def_tf
  )

study_avg_score <- data %>%
  group_by(studykey,exp_class) %>%
  summarize(avg_tot_score_est = mean(tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_out_score_est = mean(out_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_exp_score_est = mean(exp_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_a_score_est = mean(a_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_tot_score_est = case_when(
      avg_tot_score_est == 11 ~ "11",
      avg_tot_score_est <= 5 ~ "≤ 5",
      avg_tot_score_est > 5 & avg_tot_score_est < 11 ~ "6-10"
    ),
    avg_out_score_est = case_when(
      avg_out_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
    avg_exp_score_est = case_when(
      avg_exp_score_est == 3 ~ "3",
      TRUE ~ "<3"
    ),
    avg_a_score_est = case_when(
      avg_a_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
  )

study_avg_score_total <- data %>%
  group_by(studykey) %>%
  summarize(avg_tot_score_est = mean(tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_out_score_est = mean(out_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_exp_score_est = mean(exp_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_a_score_est = mean(a_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_tot_score_est = case_when(
      avg_tot_score_est == 11 ~ "11",
      avg_tot_score_est <= 5 ~ "≤ 5",
      avg_tot_score_est > 5 & avg_tot_score_est < 11 ~ "6-10"
    ),
    avg_out_score_est = case_when(
      avg_out_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
    avg_exp_score_est = case_when(
      avg_exp_score_est == 3 ~ "3",
      TRUE ~ "<3"
    ),
    avg_a_score_est = case_when(
      avg_a_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
  )
```
